page: Amazon Web Services p6-b200.48xlarge is an x86_64 architecture GPU-accelerated server instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor. The system features 192 virtual CPUs powered by dedicated Intel processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.4 GHz. This configuration provides 96 physical cores with 2.0 threads per core, backed by 2048.0 GB of system memory, yielding 10.67 GB of RAM per physical core.

The primary hardware accelerator subsystem consists of eight NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 1432 GB of GPU VRAM. For high-speed local data access, the instance includes 30400 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 200 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfers between nodes or storage systems.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this instance represents a high-density hardware class designed for massive resource consolidation, trading a high baseline operating cost for extreme parallel processing capabilities. The absence of complimentary public IPv4 addresses requires external routing configurations. This hardware profile is engineered for workloads such as large language model training, complex deep learning inference, high-throughput data science pipelines, and large-scale parallel simulations.
